blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday said that she would “never” resign from her post, despite mounting political pressure and legal challenges, including an impeachment trial. “No, no, no. I will not resign,” Duterte said in a chance interview when asked if this would ever lead to her resignation. “I will never resign from the Office of the Vice President,” she added.
